description: Ministry of Urban Development and Housing - Revision of Gazette Notification No. 2026/25 dated 05.07.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns amendments to regulations under the Condominium Property Management Authority Act, specifically revising fee structures for housing projects. It involves legal/regulatory modifications to existing legislation (the Condominium Management Authority Act) and establishes new regulatory requirements and fee schedules for different types of housing developments. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of issuing a regulatory amendment rather than describing personal portfolio responsibilities, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
